messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Economic conditions and indicators, Information society, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, Equality, inequality and social exclusion, Cultural and national identity, Social behaviour and attitudes, and Religion and values in Germany during the 2010s, matching this research need: Survey data from Germany in 2018 on political attitudes and participation, populism, democracy, refugees and immigration, media use, religion, social networks, inequality, national identity, right-wing extremism, unification, and detailed demographics.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
